verdict.rationale: The firm publishes a dedicated thought-leadership article on India's DPDP Rules 2025 by its Co-Head of Digital/TMT practice, and its TMT sector page explicitly claims data-privacy advisory expertise 'ahead of the curve,' demonstrating a documented privacy/cyber practice tied to India's DPDP Act. Missing for 10: explicit coverage or cross-border advisory claims for GDPR/CCPA specifically, and no dedicated standalone 'privacy/cyber' practice page distinct from the TMT sector page.
